title: DESTINY-Lung06: A phase 3 randomized trial of trastuzumab deruxtecan plus pembrolizumab in NSCLC
context: Background: Trial in progress. Methods: Planned enrollment of approximately 650 patients with advanced non-small cell lung cancer randomized to trastuzumab deruxtecan plus pembrolizumab versus platinum chemotherapy. Primary endpoint is progression-free survival and overall survival.
